data.long_meaning: One who is in a state of struggle or hardship, enduring and patient. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Muhtaj usually hope their child will grow to embody struggling, enduring, patient and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hindi.long_meaning: मुहताज वह व्यक्ति है जो ईश्वर की आवश्यकता का अनुभव करता है और उसका भिक्षुक है। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है क्योंकि यह सेवा और समर्पण को प्रकट करता है। अरबी मूल से निकला यह शब्द भिक्षुक या जरूरतमंद के अर्थ में प्रयोग किया जाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम पारंपरिक और आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है।

in_english.name: Muhtaj
in_english.meaning: One who feels the need for Allah, a poor one in need of Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Muhtaj is a name that signifies one who feels the need for Allah and acknowledges their poverty and dependence on Him. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'ḥ-t-j', it reflects a state of spiritual neediness and servitude. In Islamic tradition, this name holds significant spiritual meaning, emphasizing humility and reliance on Allah. Historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote a person who seeks Allah's assistance and mercy.

data.cultural_impact: The name Muhtaj holds a strong cultural significance in the Islamic community. It is derived from the Arabic word 'Muhtajah', meaning 'laden with a burden' or 'struggling'. Throughout history, this name has been adopted by individuals who have displayed immense courage and resilience in the face of adversity. In modern times, the name is often given to babies born into difficult circumstances, reminds them of their inherent strength and the potential for overcoming challenges.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Muhtaj holds deep spiritual significance in the Islamic faith. It resonates with the concept of 'Sabr', or patience, and the belief in persevering through hardship. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) once said, "There are three calamities for which patience is rewarded: Death, being sliced asunder [during burial], and calamities which befall a man and he can only find consolation therein. And the reward for patience in these, is the Garden [of Paradise]." Muhtaj holds the reminder that we are all on a journey towards spiritual growth, and the struggles and hardships we face serve as opportunities to build our character, gain strength and draw closer to God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Struggling, Enduring, Patient" symbolizes One who is in a state of struggle or hardship, enduring and patient. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Muhtaj serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of struggling, enduring, patient.
